summary: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors adopted a stock repurchase program (2026 Repurchase Program) authorizing the repurchase of up to 850,000 shares of common stock, representing approximately 4.5% of outstanding shares (19.1 million shares as of April 30, 2026). No price, premium, or expiration date beyond May 16, 2027, was specified; repurchases are at market prices, subject to market conditions and regulatory constraints. The program can be modified or discontinued at any time. This open-market repurchase program returns capital to shareholders with no structural features like a tender or fixed price. Watch for execution pace and potential suspension if economic conditions deteriorate.
